अट a. (f. टा) Roaming, wandering.
अटा f. The habit of roaming or wandering, especially of a religious mendicant.
अट्ट (I) a. (f. ट्टा) Dry, dried.
अट्ट (II) m. (according to some also n.) 1. A room on the top of a house; 2. a tower; 3. a marketplace; 4. a palatial building, नरेन्द्रमार्गाट्ट इव प्रपेदे R.vi.67.
अट्ट (III) n. Food, अट्टशूला जनपदाः Bh. (where Nīlakaṇṭha explains अट्टशूलाः by अट्टमन्नं शूलं विक्रेयं येषाम्.)
अट्ट (I) a. (f. ट्टा) Dry, dried.
अटन n. Act or habit of wandering about.
अटनि(नी) f. The notched extremity of a bow, R.xi.14.

अटवि(वी) f. A wood, a forest.

अट्ट-हासिन् m. an epithet of Śiva.
अट्टक m. An apartment on the roof of an Indian house.
अट्टालिका f. A house of two or more stories, a lofty house.
